items.hook: Catherine "Cathy" Ames, later known as Kate Trask or Kate Albey, is a fictional character and the main antagonist in John Steinbeck's 1952 novel East of Eden.
items.body: She is married to the main protagonist Adam Trask, and the mother of his twin sons, Caleb and Aron. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Hussein bin Ali proclaims himself "King of the Arab Countries".
items.body: Hussein bin Ali al-Hashimi was a Hejazi leader from the Banu Qatadah branch of the Banu Hashim clan who was the Sharif and Emir of Mecca from 1908 and, after proclaiming the Great Arab Revolt against the Ottoman Empire, King of the Hejaz, even if he refused this title, from 1916 to 1924. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
